verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੈ ਨਵਨ ਬਸੰੁਧਰ ਸਰਬ ਰਸ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: navan gavan jal niramal seetal hai navan basa(n)udhar sarab ras raas hai ||

en.bdb: Water that flows downward is always cool and clear. The earth that remains under the feet of all is the treasure-house of all the goods that are pleasurable and worth relishing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਬਾਸੁ ਬੋਹੈ ਬਨ ਨਵਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੋਤ ਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: auradh tapasiaa kai sreekha(n)dd baas bohai ban navan samu(n)dhr hot ratan pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Sandalwood tree wilted under the weight of its branches and leaves as if in supplication, spreads its fragrance and makes all the vegetation in the near vicinity fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਪਗ ਪੂਜੀਅਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਚਾਹੈ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਤਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: navan gavan pag poojeeat jagat mai chaahai charanaamirat charan raj taas hai ||

en.bdb: Of all the limbs of body, feet which remain on earth and at the lowest end of the body are worshipped. The whole world desires nectar and dust of holy feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise har bhagat jagat mai ni(n)maree bhoot kaam nihakaam dhaam bisam bisavaiaas hai ||290||

en.bdb: Similarly the worshippers of the Lord live as humble human beings in the world. Unsullied by the worldly sensualities, they remain stable and unmoved in unique love and devotion. (290)
